statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
